title: Reconcile artifact release and license metadata
body:
## Summary

- document the repository's mixed per-artifact license model and include complete Apache-2.0 terms
- reconcile ReuseFirst `v1.2.1` metadata while marking its published tag as a known-defective historical record
- record actual release mutability and attached-asset counts for all artifacts
- add a CI contract for catalog, licenses, live releases, and known historical tag defects

No tag or release was created, moved, or modified.

## Verification

- `GITHUB_TOKEN="$(gh auth token)" python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py' -v`
- `python3 -m unittest discover -s artifacts/reusefirst/tests -p 'test_*.py' -v`
- `git diff --check`
- independent review completed; all findings addressed

Tracks edoworks/factory#52.

title: Reconcile ReuseFirst release metadata
body:
## Summary

- Prepare an unreleased ReuseFirst `v1.2.1` candidate against immutable revision `30e588b4dc0d869da9b58a01d91c22d6f4931361`.
- Keep the existing `v1.2.0` tag unchanged and publication approval false.
- Correct provenance and add a candidate release note.

The candidate remains unreleased. Customer Zero evidence is maintained by
consuming factories and is not asserted as public artifact provenance here.

## Verification

```text
python3 -m unittest discover -s artifacts/reusefirst/tests
Ran 3 tests in 0.000s
OK
```

No artifact code or dependency policy changed.

title: Enforce reviewed PR workflow
body:
## Change summary

Add the repository controls needed for reviewed artifact changes: a pull
request template, CODEOWNERS, a review-contract check, contributor workflow
guidance, and safe same-repository merged-branch cleanup.

## Verification

- [x] Tests for the changed artifact pass.
- [x] Provenance is updated.
- [x] License impact is reviewed.
- [x] Release notes are updated when applicable.
- [x] No credentials, private paths, generated caches, or unsupported claims were added.

## Rubber-duck review

- Reviewer: supportfoculoom
- Review date: 2026-09-19
- Review result: No issues found. The workflow is scoped to same-repository merged branches, requires explicit review evidence in the PR body, and leaves ruleset enforcement as a repository-owner control.
- [x] I walked through the changed files and recorded every finding or explicitly recorded that no issues were found.
- [x] I checked the artifact boundary, provenance, license, tests, and release impact.

## Merge readiness

- [ ] Required review is approved.
- [ ] Required CI checks are green.
- [x] The branch is current with `main`.
